title: A Red Balloon Is Tied To My Window (Part 2) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Last time, red balloons covered your window. And one of them was hiding an eye.
You scream. Your mum runs in. She rips the curtain open.
The balloons are gone. All of them. Just a clean window and a sunny morning.
At school, everyone is weird. Too happy.
Every single person says, "Happy birthday!" when they see you.
Your teacher has a cake ready. With your name on it.
Everyone laughs. Even you, a little.
After school, there's a party at your house you didn't plan.
Everyone you know is there. All wearing red party hats.
They sing to you. Long. Slow. Too slow.
*And every guest goes pop. One after another. Like balloons. Until you're alone with the cake.
In the quiet, a little card falls from the ceiling. "See you next year."
Tell me in the comments, and follow for more stories from Creepyville.
